summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine warrant exercise. The company received notice for exercise of 3,989,027 warrants at 40 pence each, raising £1,595,610.80. Only 100,000 warrants remain, expiring 25 January 2027. The new shares will be admitted to AIM around 20 August 2026, ranking pari passu with existing shares. Post-admission, issued capital will be 198,797,008 ordinary shares. This is a standard capital-raising event, not a special situation. No premium, tender, strategic review, or activist involvement. Watch for potential dilution absorption, but no risk-arb angle.
